v.xgroup_create('s','g','0')
v.xreadgroup('g','c1',{'s':'>'})  # creates consumer c1, PEL 2 entries

p=v.dump('s')
print("payload len:", len(p))

now=int(time.time()*1000)
# scan 8-byte little endian values within +/- 5 sec of now

print("candidate mstime offsets:", found)
print("hex:", p.hex())
v.flushdb()
